desc: The T-Bolt Composite Sporter is made for the "avid shooter" with its durable stock with a raised comb for better scope-to-stock alignment. Features a steel receiver, drilled/tapped for scope mounts, semi-match chamber and recessed crown; adjustable trigger; composite stock with a spare magazine storage compartment in buttplate for Double Helix Magazine; straight pull bolt-action; top-tang safety and adjustable trigger. Includes sling swivel studs and Double Helix Magazine.
